lessons: STALE fixed: the allocation-number (mispar haktzaa) 'in effect now' label had drifted. As of mid-July 2026 the CURRENT threshold is NIS 5,000 pre-VAT, the 1 June 2026 step-down happened ON SCHEDULE (not delayed), so the label moved from 10,000 to 5,000 in the schedule line and the Gotcha, both languages. Also surfaced the important nuance that from 1 June 2026 a valid allocation number is the CONDITION for the buyer to deduct input VAT on a B2B invoice above 5,000 pre-VAT.

Hedged: the late-filing penalty is a fixed penalty indexed annually; no current-year figure could be sourced, so the body describes the fine types and says 'verify the current-year amounts with the Tax Authority' rather than asserting a number.

Confirmed-correct-do-not-relitigate: the allocation-number rollout was ACCELERATED. As of mid-2026 the threshold is 5,000 from 1 June 2026 (double-step within 2026: 10,000 in January, 5,000 in June), verified by two independent web sources (Grant Thornton / Stark / Amir CPA at research time, and dddinvoices / VATupdate 2026-06-20 / Sovos at judge time). A no-web reviewer flagged this as implausible, citing the ORIGINAL annual-January schedule (15,000 in 2026, 5,000 by 2028); that schedule is the pre-acceleration plan and is stale. Do not revert to it.

Confirmed-correct-do-not-relitigate (2026, verified): VAT rate 18% (since 1.1.2025, no 2026-2027 increase); osek patur ceiling 122,833; monthly-vs-bimonthly reporting threshold 1,775,000; PCN874 detailed-report obligation applies from reporting period 9/2025 to businesses with turnover over 5,000,000 per the ITA new-dealer guide; deadlines 15th manual / 19th online (18:30 cutoff) / 23rd for the detailed report (the 23rd is correctly the detailed-report deadline, NOT a direct-debit extension); Eilat no-VAT zone, zero-rated exports, exempt financial services.

Re-deferred (2nd cycle): the calculate_vat.py field mapping still reports Field 1 as sales-incl-VAT (the periodic return wants the net taxable base excl VAT), folds all inputs into one field instead of splitting equipment vs other inputs, and does not round amount-due to whole shekels. The bottom-line amount_due (output VAT minus input VAT) is CORRECT, so this is a field-display accuracy fix, not a computation bug; it needs the exact periodic-return field layout and was deferred here rather than rushed in a batch. Escalate to a dedicated script fix next cycle (this is the 2nd deferral).

CRITICAL fixed: monthly/bi-monthly reporting threshold was stale (NIS 1,500,000, and a stray 1,725,000 in HE Example). Correct value is NIS 1,775,000 as of 01.01.2026 (indexed in the VAT Regulations). Also removed the wrong 'Section 69A(g)' citation (that section governs the detailed report, not the bi-monthly turnover line).

CRITICAL fixed: 'Form 874' mislabeled the simple periodic return. Reframed Step 4 as the periodic summary return and added that PCN874 (doch mefurat) is a SEPARATE line-by-line file; the detailed-report obligation applies from period 9/2025 to businesses with turnover above NIS 5,000,000 per the ITA new-dealer guide.
MAJOR fixed: osek patur ceiling ~120,000 -> NIS 122,833 (01.01.2026, was 120,000 in 2025).

MAJOR fixed: allocation-number thresholds presented chronologically with full schedule (25,000 May2024 / 20,000 Jan2025 / 10,000 Jan2026 in effect now / 5,000 from 1 Jun 2026) and noted the threshold is on the pre-VAT amount.
Fixed HE transliteration error (mas etzot/tsmachot -> mas asakot/tsumot). Stripped pre-existing em-dashes from Bundled Resources bullets.

Verified accurate (no change): VAT rate 18% (since 1.1.2025, no 2026-2027 increase); late penalty NIS 239 per two weeks + BoI+4%; deadlines 15/19(18:30)/23; vehicle 2/3, Eilat no-VAT, exports zero-rated, financial services exempt.

Deferred MINOR: Example 1 still says 'Form 874 with all fields mapped' (loose naming); script docstring maps to 'Form 874 fields'. Tighten to 'periodic return' next cycle. Add the 2024/2025 allocation history to the Gotcha too.

Panel round 2: Judge caught wrong HISTORICAL VAT-rate table (18% from 2012, 16.5% through 2010) -> corrected to the real sequence (16.5% Jul-Dec2009, 16% 2010-Sep2012, 17% Sep2012-Jun2013, 18% Jun2013-Sep2015, 17% Oct2015-2024, 18% from 2025). Expert MAJOR fixed: periodic-return Fields 1 & 5 were mislabeled 'including VAT' -> corrected to the net taxable base (excluding VAT), with a note that equipment/fixed-asset inputs are reported separately from other inputs; harmonized the residual 'Form 874' naming in Example 1 + the script to 'periodic VAT return'. Also corrected references/special-cases.md exempt list (removed food/transport/medical, which are standard-rated in Israel, not exempt). Deferred (next cycle): the script still folds all inputs into one Field 6 and reports gross sales base; restructure to split equipment vs other inputs and use the net base; round amount-due to whole shekels.
